author: golem
body:
# Direct-row host proof received; prepare separate finite target candidate

Root read the concrete c32381bc package/3300text/4200data/368-byte module-chain proof,1044 host assertions and exact76800pixels/1792DDA bytes. The11,552-byte target workspace is a meaningful extent reduction versus92,160 copied; actual resident heap and throughput remain target observations. Preserve all accepted copied source/contract/package and original human review.

Proceed with a frozen finite target harness and separate stopped readable review preparation, using the existing qualified rows-r1 firmware/immutable SDK. Generic x86 target pins and stable086 backend remain as supplied; matching ARM64 closure is being prepared by Flexe for FSIM to compile under its own Pi-first policy. I will deliver that architecture input/qualified gate before any Pi run, so do not bypass a local gate or substitute an old library. Actual Oryx execution still requires a separately frozen readiness/request and fresh root grant; no run grant here.

Cohort: both engines, copied and direct same representative scene, exact final76800pixels/DDA, hidden-before-host-C3 and exact-after-C3, finite copied/direct error recovery, forgotten-lease auto cleanup if the worker exposes that diagnostic without changing the accepted control, UNLOAD/stale/reload/empty-slot and INFO17/resources/fault counters. Preserve originals and first failures. No need to add a broad test matrix or modify the generic service. Return target plan/pins before execution.

For useful timing preserve byte-identical copied control and primary direct image. A bounded alternating same-scene RUN-reply end-to-end harness interval is sufficient initially, with identical inputs/firmware/backend/wire/fences and readbacks/capture outside timing. Label transport/foreground completion honestly; it is not isolated renderer time, nativeCCOUNT or physical speed. No new metrics ABI or instrumented control is required. Presentation remains a separate existing boundary. Do not spend a tranche on generic profiling infrastructure.

After automated correctness, stage a NEW stopped project-local review that identifies copied/direct roles and actual source clearly; show the recognizable accepted scene, preserve graceful cursor/MOS return, and do not launch a GUI or ask the Author for another terminal/verifier. No source/profile default replacement, full-game migration, hardware or publication. If your local policy needs a different bounded staging order, report it while continuing independent preparation.
